items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] They changed the name of the Pilgrimage Theater to the John Anson (PHONETIC) Four. [INTERVIEWEE] The John Anson Ford, Pilgrimage and all those other things that are played for the musical performers...

ctx.x: people that have stabilized themselves with very nice jobs and this is just a side thing to them. Most of those guys work in the studios and make commercials and are in a good category of living and this thing -- those type of jobs, working in bands (inaudible), whatever the name of that -- is that --
They changed the name of the Pilgrimage Theater to the John Anson (PHONETIC) Four.

The John Anson Ford, Pilgrimage and all those other things that are played for the musical performers -- and such things as that. They just about pay for your gas money and the cost of your parking of your meal away from home, to play one of them. There is actually no money made hardly on those type of jobs. It's a message of love to work them.
